title: Curseberer (Origins x Enigmatic Legacy)
body:
This is a simple datapack for Origins and Enigmatic Legacy. Instead of every player receiving the Ring of Seven Curses, the curses are tied to an origin, the Cursebearer

Origin: The Cursebearer

Pros:
- +1 Looting Level
- +1 Fortune Level
- +400% Experience dropped
- +10 Enchanting Power in Enchanting Table
- Unique drops from some creatures.
- Functionality of Ring of Ender.
- You can create and use unique relics.

Cons:
- You receive double damage from ANY source.
- Neutral creatures are aggressive towards you.
- Armor is 30% less effective.
- Monsters receive 50% less damage from you.
- When on fire, you burn forever.
- Every death tears your soul apart.
- You suffer from incurable insomnia.

This origin has not been made with the possibility of breaking the ring or changing your origin in mind
